blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Alex Eala packing out venues is nothing out of the ordinary. Tuesday was no different. Only this time, it was at Eusebio Gymnasium of Pasig Central Elementary School, where Eala conducted a tennis clinic for young students in a homecoming event. Among those in attendance were President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto and Department of Education (Deped) Secretary Sonny Angara as well as Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz and two-time Olympian EJ Obiena. “When I was a kid, I competed early.
